ValidationRule.description: Required fields when Deactivate Access is chosen from the Support Ticket pick-list
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISPICKVAL(Support_Type__c, "Deactivate Access"),
$Profile.Name=="Eligibility Worker Supervisor", $Profile.Name=="Fiscal Worker Supervisor", $Profile.Name=="Provider Worker Supervisor", $Profile.Name=="Universal User", $Profile.Name=="CCCAP Program Internal Team", $Profile.Name=="System Administrator", $Profile.Name=="System Admin", $Profile.Name=="CHATS System Administrator" , OR( ISBLANK(Last_Name__c), ISBLANK(First_name__c), ISBLANK(CHATS_Supervisor__c), ISBLANK(Start_Deactivation_Change_Date__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For a Deactivate Access, Please ensure the following fields have been completed: Start/Deactivation/Change date; First Name; Last Name; Email Address; CHATS Supervisor.
